Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concludes that Richard Fleischer is older based solely on the birth dates of the two directors, without considering the release years of the films. The task specifically asks for the film whose director is older at the time of the film's release. While Richard Fleischer was born earlier (1916) than Nanni Loy (1925), the film "The Incredible Sarah" was released in 1976, making Richard Fleischer 60 years old at the time. In contrast, "Heads I Win, Tails You Lose" was released in 1982, making Nanni Loy 57 years old at the time. Thus, Nanni Loy was older at the time of the release of his film. The Planner fails to incorporate the release years into the comparison, leading to the incorrect final answer.
